title: Review of c07's wall-tilt drive (negative): on fresh seed 4, a_s = 0, 3, 7 give max 1.4, 1.8 and 1.6 body lengths, and a_s=7 dies out by t=10000; no swimming (Supported)
summary: Looked at the README table and img/a_s7.png, then ran the finding's world.py on fresh seed 4 (128^2, T=10000, labkit) at a_s = 0, 3 and 7 via WORLD_P. Max body lengths 1.4, 1.8, 1.6 (finding: 1.6, 1.5, 1.6); cells at the end 16, 13, 0 (finding: 18, 15, 5); persistent splits 17, 11, 7 (numbers.txt). At a_s=3 the sheet shows ringed cells that bud, merge and grow into giants but do not travel (rerun_a3/seed4/sheet.png); at a_s=7 the population dies out entirely on this seed (the finding's seed kept 5). The negative holds: this label-free tilt drive does not make the cells swim; 1.8 BL at a_s=3 is slightly above the finding's 1.6 but far below the 3 BL bar.

observations.M: numbers.txt: max BL 1.4 / 1.8 / 1.6 at a_s 0 / 3 / 7 on seed 4; rerun_a3/seed4/sheet.png cells do not travel

controls_run.M: rerun_a0/seed4: a_s=0 control on the same seed

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed, three settings; as the finding says, other sig_s or wall-average widths were not tried.
